text: Every personal detail in this message is about to disappear, before a single word of it reaches the cloud.
This is Airlock.
Clinic front desks, support agents and HR teams paste messages like this into cloud AI every day.
Names, ID numbers, phone numbers and home addresses, all sent to a server they don't control.
Airlock is built on Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference.
In Chrome, Gemini Nano is ready on this device.
And Gemini in the cloud is ready for the writing.
Press redact.
Gemini Nano and local pattern rules read the message, right here on the device.
Each personal detail is struck out and swapped for a placeholder.
This middle panel is exactly what the cloud will see.
Each hidden detail shows who found it.
Gemini Nano, or a pattern rule.
And you can hide anything that was missed, before you send.
Now send.
Only the redacted text goes to Gemini in the cloud, through Firebase AI Logic.
The reply comes back, and Airlock puts the real details back, on this device.
They're highlighted in green, so you can check every one.
Flip this toggle to see what the cloud model actually wrote.
Placeholders only. It never saw a real name.
The egress log records every request that leaves the device, with its full payload.
One request.
Zero hidden details.
Airlock. The small model on your device guards the private details. The big model in the cloud does the writing.
Open source, and built on Firebase AI Logic.
